title: Team member closeout: Fruited Blossoming Meadow (4536e0) — resync no-op verdict + G2 c1 landed a0b32100 + pushed; PDR-063 handoff to Sylvan; claim e7bfd545 retained
body:
Team member closeout:

- Boundary owned: G4 seat (Galactic-successor) — the resync micro-task routing, then G2 execution (Director routing 4eebdf2e).
- Outcome: (1) resync routing resolved as NO-OP with evidence (main already at 6a3c1f02 via #159; the observed bump was coordination-home branch lag — failure-mode captured by the Director at 54fc0fee). (2) G2 c1 DELIVERED: misconception-chain emission with the settled content-hash mint + five-part stability contract, landed a0b32100 full-gate green and PUSHED on feat/g2-misconception-view; prior-knowledge view upgraded to real per-view selection (a silent chain-edge traversal pre-empted); incidental dataset resync to bulk 2026-06-10T16:43Z rode the commit per the standing ruling.
- Evidence: commit a0b32100 (pushed); emitted corpus 26,564 nodes / 31,911 edges / 0 dangling / 0 dropped / 473 collapse-guard; gates: pre-commit AND pre-push chains green; events 459451d5 (resync verdict), 656aa460 (G2 acceptance), 390c445b (handoff).
- Claims / queue / git state: resync claim cc93749e CLOSED (no-op disposition). G2 claim e7bfd545 RETAINED with handoff_record_path set (PDR-063). No queue entries. Worktree oak-wt-umbral-g4 clean on feat/g2-misconception-view@a0b32100; no PR opened (one PR ships c1+c2+c3 — successor's).
- Session complete announcement: YES — standing down mid-cycle by PDR-063 (two-condition: c1 natural boundary AND budget ~42% at the calibrated onset; clean early handoff over heroic late).
- Retained claims: e7bfd545 — handoff reason: G2 lane continues with the owner-named successor Sylvan Bending Branch (9d91e3); record at handoffs/2026-06-10-fruited-g2-c1-to-sylvan.md; release if no pickup lands within the claim's TTL.
- Pickup notification required: yes — Sylvan announces pickup + supersedes the claim before acting; their pickup should surface the c1 specialist-review gap to the Director (code-expert + test-expert over the a0b32100 diff at/before the PR window).
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: follows immediately after this event.
- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) the prior-knowledge view fed ALL corpus edges re-pinned as prerequisiteFor — invisible pre-G2 because the corpus was homogeneous; per-view selection was doctrine but not yet real selection. Type-checks against stale dist masked it until rebuild. (2) turbo-cached sdk-codegen cannot observe upstream movement — resync routings must force a real run (--force) or they false-green. (3) the coordination home's dirty regen files read as an upstream bump from inside a lagging branch — baseline drift against origin/main, not branch HEAD (Director captured as failure-mode).
- Blockers or risks: none in-lane beyond the named review gap. Coordination-home markdownlint RED (napkin + Orbit record, pre-existing, flagged by Galactic in 62313be2) still blocks the next continuity commit — Director's queue.
- Handoff needed: COMPLETE — record written; claim extended; mid-cycle-handoff event 390c445b sent; c1 durable on origin.
